BikeAthens Joy Ride

Athens, GA · Prince Avenue · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-dropFamily

BikeAthens Joy Ride is a social group ride in Athens, GA. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from BikeAthens shop (under Daily Groceries). About 6–8 miles, casual, slow. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, slow. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bikeathens the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BikeAthens Joy Ride group ride

Slow in-town ride from the BikeAthens community shop. Six to eight miles on streets and multi-use paths with a ride leader up front and a sweeper in back. Nobody gets left. Optional hang at Athentic Brewing after.
